ddns-scripts.reason: User requested ddns-go; provider and domain settings must be migrated locally.

luci-app-serverchan.reason: Use official-feed WeChatPush 3.6.12 for ServerChan, IP changes, device online/offline, CPU/temperature and scheduled notifications. The old serverchan schema is not imported; credentials, thresholds and notification choices must be configured locally. Built-in per-client traffic notifications still depend on unavailable legacy wrtbwmon and are not replaced by the separate nlbwmon page. Target compilation and actual notification delivery remain unverified.

luci-app-ddns.reason: ddns-go LuCI UI; old ddns UCI schema is incompatible.

luci-i18n-ddns-zh-cn.reason: Translation is not a service; review translation availability separately.

luci-app-filetransfer.reason: The locked official LuCI File Manager implements upload/download; its UI and configuration differ from the legacy file-transfer page.

luci-app-accesscontrol.reason: Use the locked official Firewall/Traffic Rules UI: source MAC, weekdays, start_time and stop_time are supported by the pinned firewall4 backend. Review old firewall rules, timezone and rule ordering locally; established connections and offload behavior still require runtime acceptance.

luci-app-wireguard.reason: The locked WireGuard protocol package includes interface configuration, peer status, its menu and RPC implementation. Keep the existing network UCI schema; provision secrets locally.

luci-proto-bonding.reason: Bonding is now a device type in the official Network UI. Convert the old protocol section into a network device section; do not import the old protocol verbatim.

luci-app-ntpc.reason: Use BusyBox sysntpd and System/Time Synchronization. NTPD must stay enabled in the resolved BusyBox configuration. Server names move to system.ntp; ntpclient interval/drift options are not copied.

ntpclient.reason: Use the target's sysntpd NTP client, with BUSYBOX_DEFAULT_NTPD=y; migrate server candidates locally rather than restoring old ntpclient UCI.
